name: BXH TokenStakingPoolDelegate pays USDT bonus at the live BXH/USDT spot quote
summary: BXH's TokenStakingPoolDelegate paid pending BXH rewards in USDT, converted at the BXH/USDT pair's live reserves and paid from its own USDT balance. The attacker flash-borrowed USDT, bought BXH to inflate its USDT price, then harvested the small pending reward of an earlier vUSDT stake as about 40k USDT, draining the bonus balance.
notes: The admin Safe's add() created pool 0 with the bonus enabled, USDT as bonus token and the BXH/USDT pair as its price source (swapPairAddress, the slot named); without it the spot-quote payout path is unreachable. Later allocPoint and deposit-limit changes only scale rewards.
The attacker's earlier vUSDT stake stays in the pool and is not subtracted; the 200 USDT it sent to the pool in the anchor is netted as its own round trip.
